build: make web-mjs ENV_FILE=.github/.env_8.4.static.ci WITH_SDL=1 PHP_DIST_DIR=.cache/sdl-focus/runtime PHP_ASSET_DIR=.cache/sdl-focus/runtime CPU_COUNT=4 MAX_LOAD=8
notes: The 4 focused cases are included in the 87-case Chromium input/text/pointer/binding suite, not additional distinct cases.
Three actual SDL editor tests use the matching pair installed in packages/php-wasm and a restarted Vite dev server.
Firefox and WebKit each verify ordinary/shadow-root keyboard focus and the textarea text-input transport. Chromium also verifies EditContext.
The preceding runtime prevents all tested textarea typing and retains A/Shift after blur; the corrected runtime permits typing/editing/shortcuts and clears native held state.
Returning to the canvas resumes native keys and Unicode text; unrelated editors do not generate SDL input events.
Physical OS IME/controller coverage and the complete newest-source PHP/profile CI matrix remain pending.
